decisions.reason: The building digital twin service still shows only a website mention after two years, so its uncertain value has not yet resolved, but holding it costs little and the digital twin market is still emerging.
The authentication and delegation service overlaps strongly with the more visible identity service E and may be folded into it, but keeping it as a complementary component costs little for now.
The open GIS development framework anchors the firm's component and standards strategy and has high option value at low marginal cost.
The identity service was actively announced and fits the core GIS integration business, so its prospects justify continued commitment.
The consulting workshop is new, has its own page, and builds on existing consulting expertise at minimal cost, so it is far too early to abandon it.
